messages:
Ellen (CS): quick check after cutover for OrchidBridge private/VPC. Open: audit log retention must be 180d per regs, KMS cross-account access needs explicit role, and we saw short 403 spikes on S3 writes. owners?
Hank (OrchidBridge PM): bucket=orchid-priv-logs, key alias/orchid-key. SOC needs 180d. 403s at 13:11 UTC during a burst.
Ravi (Solutions): likely collector concurrency + KMS envelope contention. I'll reduce concurrency and add jittered backoff; will run a 20m soak.
Tess (Security Eng): KMS pattern: customer key with key policy granting arn:aws:iam::orchidacct:role/orchid-priv-ingest kms:Decrypt + kms:GenerateDataKey; add aws:SourceAccount condition. Recommend yearly rotation (365d) and runbook steps.
Ellen (CS): actions: Ravi change collector (due TOM), Tess draft key policy snippet (due Wed), Hank apply lifecycle 180d and confirm (due Wed). ops-bot: Deploy queued: collector-tune (run id: o-7731).
ops-bot: Deploy finished: collector-tune applied.
Ravi (Solutions): soak results: 20m, zero 403s, avg put latency 130ms. rolling to prod.
Ellen (CS): marking account health amber->green-with-notes once lifecycle applied. Closing for now; reopen if issues.
